notes: Use Anti-Magic Shell aggressively against poison applications.
Anti-Magic Zone is especially valuable for Synchronized Venom and Mass Envenom; interrupt Mass Envenom first when possible.
Use Wraith Walk to break Bloodthorn Roots and Anti-Magic Shell while soaking Lightblossom Beam.
Anti-Magic Zone can cover Bedrock Surge when the group is stacked closely enough to remain inside it.
Use Anti-Magic Shell when clearing a Rotten Mushroom and plan Anti-Magic Zone for Sentinel of Winter's sustained group damage.
Every boss has group-wide magic damage and close positioning, making Anti-Magic Zone consistently valuable.
Anti-Magic Shell can cross Malefic Wave without losing uptime, but it does not replace the encounter gateway for the rest of the party.
Death's Advance can resist Unstable Singularity's pull.
Use Anti-Magic Zone as a targeted external when a full-party stack is impractical rather than waiting indefinitely.
Death's Advance prevents Gale Force's push, while Anti-Magic Shell extends the time Frost can safely intercept a Lightning Spire beam.
Anti-Magic Shell can block Gilded Destruction's damage.
Control Undead has a real dungeon target here, but coordinate its five-minute refresh and remember that death breaks control.
Death's Advance can prevent the guide's named Source of Magic push; no spell ID is asserted because the guide link resolves to an unrelated homonymous player ability.
Use Anti-Magic Zone during Kokia Blazehoof's best close-stack group-damage window.

recommendations: Use Blinding Sleet for the group stop, then Mind Freeze and Death Grip on remaining susceptible casts.
Frost has no dedicated utility interaction; swap and kill the emissary quickly.
Collapse toward allies and intercept assigned orbs; the guide identifies no Frost talent that changes this response.
Pre-casting Anti-Magic Shell blocks the debuff but also denies Rift Essence; with Unyielding Will, remove it after application to preserve the benefit.
